entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A RAG approach that combines knowledge graph generation and query-focused summarization to support human sensemaking over entire text corpora.

entities.name: vector RAG
entities.description: A baseline RAG approach using vector retrieval, compared against GraphRAG.

entities.name: map-reduce source text summarization
entities.description: A global but graph-free approach using map-reduce summarization, compared against GraphRAG.

entities.name: query-focused summarization
entities.description: A procedural step in GraphRAG that generates summaries focused on specific queries.

entities.name: knowledge graph generation
entities.description: A procedural step in GraphRAG that creates a knowledge graph from text corpora.

entities.name: comprehensiveness
entities.description: A measure of the completeness of answers provided by the RAG system.

entities.name: diversity
entities.description: A measure of the variety of answers provided by the RAG system.

entities.name: token cost
entities.description: A measure of the computational resource usage (tokens) for generating answers.

entities.name: human sensemaking
entities.description: The downstream application of understanding and interpreting entire text corpora.

entities.name: Gpt-4 technical report
entities.description: A technical report on GPT-4, cited in the references.
